selected_evidence.summary: Shows the 8181 listener, HTTP 200 application response, matching data checksum, Enforcing state, httpd_t confinement, persistent http_port_t mapping, firewall allowance, and closed port 80.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts automatically and survives restart without changing the installed OS release or kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Confirms the original and final RHEL 10.0 release/kernel, enabled and active Apache service, preserved application data, clean service state, and successful final unprivileged client request.
Captures the healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered application, security controls, firewall, SSH access, listener, and data.
